content: Yesu Pilato Ansɩ́tɔ́ Lɩɩ́
Ɔyɩ kɛhɛ nyankɩ-nyankɩ a, Yudafɔ ahandɛ-ahandɛ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ befia kɩtá agywɩɩn. Akʋ bʋgyi, Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn, Mose mbla asunápʋ́ pʋ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ atráhɛ
. Ɩnʋ bɛha bɛklɩ́ɩ Yesu, pʋ́ mʋ yɔ́wa Pilato ɩbɩtɔ.
Pilato lɛ́fɩtɛ́ Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́gyí Yudafɔ owíe amʋ nɩ?” Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ee, mʋ́ fablɩ́ á!”
Ɩnʋ igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ bɛka asʋ́n tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ dɩ́nká Yesusʋ.
Mʋ́ sʋ Pilato lɛ́fɩtɛ́ Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Kɩ asʋ́n tsɔtsɔɔtsɔá baká dɩ́nká fʋ́sʋ́, fʋma mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ lɛ́?”
Támɛ Yesu mɛlɛ asʋansʋ ɔnɔ́. Mʋ sʋ ɩlɔwa Pilato wánwan.
Yesu Lowu Ɩpɔ́n Ha
Katsʋn Nkɛ kugyíkʋtɔ á, igyi ɔmásʋ́ ogyípʋ́ Pilato amándɩ́ɛ́ ánɩ́ obési obu adɩpʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋlɛá amʋ́ onutó bʋdeklé há amʋ́.
Oyin ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Baraba mʋa mʋ aba bʋda obu alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ. Bɔkʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ ɔmásʋ́, kpokiti lɛ́da, bɔmɔ ɔha mʋ́tɔ́.
Ɔdɔm amʋ́ʋ́ bɔyɔ Pilato wá yóbwií ɩpa há mʋ bɛɛ, osíi obu ɔdɩpʋ́ ɔkʋlɛ ha amʋ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ otetsíá bwɛ́ há amʋ́ ámʋ.
Mʋ́ʋ́ Pilato lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩdéklé mlɩaa, nsíi Yudafɔ Owíe anfɩ ha mlɩ lóó?”
Ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ alɩ, tsúfɛ́ olowun ánɩ́ Yesu ɩwɩ olu sʋ́ Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ bakɩ́tá mʋ ba mʋ.
Igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ bɛha ɔdɔm amʋ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, bʋkókoli Pilato, osi Baraba mboún ha amʋ́.
Pilato lɛ́trá fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntɔ mbwɛ́ɛ ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ mlɩdɛ́tɩ mlɩaa, Yudafɔ Owíe amʋ?”
Ɩnʋ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bɔsʋrá okitikíti bɛɛ, “Da mʋ manta oyikpalíhɛsʋ!”
Pilato lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Tsitsa mɔmʋ alabwɛ́?” Támɛ bɛlasʋ́rá okitikíti kʋ́klʋ́kʋ́ʋ́ bɛɛ “Da mʋ manta oyikpalíhɛsʋ!”
Pilato dékléá ɔbɔ́bwɛ ɔdɔm amʋ apɛ́ há amʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ olesi Baraba há amʋ́, ɔlɛha mʋ ɩsá akɔpʋ́ bɛpɩtɩ́ Yesu mplɩ, ɔlɔpʋ mʋ wá amʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋyɛ́da mʋ manta oyikpalíhɛsʋ.
Yesu Ahinlá Bwɛ
Ɩsá akɔpʋ́ ámʋ bɛkpa Yesu ya ɔmásʋ́ ogyípʋ́ amʋ wóyítɔ́. Bɛtɩ amʋ́ aba ɩsá akɔpʋ́ atráhɛ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́, bɛda Yesu ɔbʋn.
Bɔpʋ ligá pɛpɛ kʋ wá mʋ, bɔlʋ obungyo-awu, bwɛ́ mʋ́ owíepa bun mʋ nwun.
Ɩnʋ bɔbwɛ mʋ ahinlá, bɛtɩ mʋ bɛɛ, “Yudafɔ Owíe, fʋ́ nkpasʋ ɔnlɩnsʋ!” Bɔtswɩ opé!
Ɩnʋ bɔpʋ oyí sísi mʋ nwuntɔ, tutúu atsʋnɔ́ wʋ́lɩ́ mʋ, dá akpawunu mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Bɔbwɛ mʋ ahinlá tá á, bɔwɔɩ́ amʋ́ ligá pɛpɛ amʋ, yínkía mʋ onutó atadɩɛ wá mʋ, bɛkpa mʋ dálɩ bɛyɛ́da mʋ mántá oyikpalíhɛsʋ.
Yesu Da Mántá Oyikpalíhɛsʋ
Befia Kireneyin ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Simon, ogyi Aleksandro mʋa Rufo ɔsɩ́. Otsú abú asɩ ɔbá, bɛka mʋ hɩ́ɛ́ bɛɛ, ɔsʋ́ra oyikpalíhɛ amʋ.
Mʋ́ʋ́ bɛkpa Yesu ya ɔtɩnɛkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ ɩnʋ Golgota. Mʋ́ asɩ gyí, “Nwun Okokobi Otsiákpá.”
Bɔpʋ afá kʋá ɩtɛba ɩwɩɔsɩn asɩ wá ntátɔ́ tin Yesu ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ onúu, támɛ omonu.
Bɛda mʋ mántá oyikpalíhɛ amʋsʋ tá á, beye mʋ atadɩɛtɔ. Ɩnʋ bɔtswɩ abi pʋ́kɩ ɔhagyíɔha ogyíkpá.
Ɩbɔ́bwɛ fɛ́ nyankɩ dokwebátɔ́ bɛda mʋ mántá oyikpalíhɛsʋ.
Mʋ́ʋ́ bɔwanlɩ́n tɔ́á sʋá bʋdɛ mʋ da mántá oyikpalíhɛ amʋsʋ dɩ́nká mʋ awunso bɛɛ, “Yudafɔ Owíe.”
Bɛda awikplu abanyɔ́ akʋ ɛ́ mántá nyikpalíhɛsʋ tsɩ́a mʋtɔ. Ɔkʋlɛ bʋ mʋ gyɔpɩsʋ, ɔkʋlɛ ɛ́ bʋ mʋ bɩnasʋ.
Ɩnʋ atsʋ́npʋ bɔkpʋkpʋ́ʋ nwuntɔ, blɩ́ mʋ ɩwɩ abususʋ bɛɛ, “Yɛ́ɛ fʋ́ fɛɛ, fɛ́talɩ́ bwíé Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa amʋ, lápwɛ́ mʋ nkɛnsá owítɔ́ nɩ́?
Hɔ fʋ́ ɩwɩ, afʋkplɩ tsu oyí ámʋsʋ akɩ!”
Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ amʋ ɛ́ bɔbwɛ mʋ ahinlá bɛɛ, “Ɔlɔhɔ ahá nkpa, támɛ ɔmɛtálɩ́ hɔ mʋ ɩwɩ.
Nɩ́ mʋgyí Israelfɔ owíe, Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu lɛ́da mʋ ofúli) a, ɔkplɩ́ɩ tsu oyí ámʋsʋ awun, ahɔ mʋ gyi!” Ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bɛda mántá oyísʋ́ mʋ gyɔpɩsʋ mʋ́a bɩnasʋ ámʋ ɛ́ bɔbwɛ mʋ ahinlá.
Yesu Lowu
Brɛ́á dódúanyɔ lɛda á, owí lɛta ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ amʋsʋ fɛ́ɛ́ alɩɩ yɔ́fʋn ntʋ́pwɛ dɔsatɔ.
Dɔsa ámʋtɔ a, Yesu lɔ́kplʋn kʋ́klʋ́kʋ́ʋ́, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Eloi, Eloi, Lama Sabaktani?” Mʋ́ asɩ gyí, “Mɩ́ Bulu, mɩ́ Bulu, ntogyi sʋ́ fakpá mɩ́ ɔma?”
Ahá amʋ́ʋ́ bʋlɩɩ́ ɩnʋ ámʋtɔ akʋ bonu asʋ́n ánfɩ, bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Mlɩnu, ɔdɛ Elia kpolí.”
Ɩnʋ amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́srɩ́ tsú ɔsapɔ, pʋ́dá ntá ɔdáɩtɔ, pʋ́yi oyísʋ́, tsú mʋ́ fʋ́a pʋ́tin mʋ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, onúu. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩlɩɩ akɩ bɛɛ, Elia ɔbɛ́ba bɛsɩɛɩ́ mʋ lɛ́ oyí ámʋsʋ?”
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɔ́kplʋn kʋ́klʋ́kʋ́ʋ́, ɔlɛlɛ ɔŋɛ́.
Ɩnʋnʋ Bulu lɛ́balɩ́ tatiá bɔpʋká ɔtswɛ́kpa obu ámʋtɔ anyɔ, tsú awunso beyi asɩ.
Brɛ́á ɩsá akɔpʋ́ ɔhandɛá ɔlɩɩ́ Yesu ansɩ́tɔ́ ɔdɛkɩ́ɩ lówun alɩá Yesu lɛ́lɛ ɔŋɛ́ tráhɛ a, ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ “Lɛ́lɛ́, Bulu mʋ Bi oyin ánfɩ gyí!”
Atsɩ akʋ ɛ́ bʋlɩɩ́ ɩfʋ́ntɔ́ bʋdɛkɩ́ɩ sɩsɩ́. Amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ gyí, Magdalayintse Maria, Salome pʋ́ Maria ánɩ́ ɔlɔkwɩɩ́ Yakobo mʋa mʋ gyama Yosef.
Amʋ́ ɛ́ betsiá buo Yesu, tsíá kɩ mʋsʋ brɛ́á ɔbʋ Galilea. Atsɩ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ akʋá bobuo mʋ ba Yerusalem ɛ́ bʋbʋ ɩnʋ.
Yesu Pulá
Ɛkɛ ámʋ igyi ɛkɛá Yudafɔ bʋtɔpʋ́lá ɩwɩ asa bʋtegyi amʋ́ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́. Brɛ́á owí dɛpɔ́ɔn a,
Arimateayin Yosef lɔ́wa ɩklʋn yɔ́ Pilato wá yɔ́kʋlɩ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, osíi Yesu fúli ha mʋ amʋpula. Yudafɔ asʋ́n ogyípʋ́ ogyi, bʋtobú mʋ. Mʋ ɛ́ ɔdɛ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɔkpa kɩ́ɩ.
Ɩlɔwa Pilato wánwan ánɩ́ Yesu lawúna wu. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛtɩ mʋ ɩsá akɔpʋ́ ɔhandɛ, fɩ́tɛ́ mʋ nɩ́ olowu ɩlawá ɔpá.
Brɛ́á ɩsá akɔpʋ́ ɔhandɛ amʋ lótsulá mʋ́sʋ́ á, Pilato lési fúli amʋ há Yosef.
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yosef lɔ́hɔ ɔhráda, ɔlɔyɔ yɛ́sɩɛɩ́ Yesu lɛ́ oyí ámʋsʋ, kɩ́klɩ mʋ wá ɔhráda ámʋtɔ, tsú mʋ yópulá ɔbɔ́ kʋá bɛda bʋtátɔ́, olemináa ibwi yíléyílé kʋ tin ɔbɔ́ ámʋ ɔnɔ́.
Magdalayintse Maria mʋa Yosef mʋ yin Maria bowun Yesu opulákpá.
